request: Can we replace --hyperlink-format with a fixed vscode link format and reject user-supplied URL templates, so every result opens in our standard editor?

source.request: Can we replace --hyperlink-format with a fixed vscode link format and reject user-supplied URL templates, so every result opens in our standard editor?
source.settled: Search-result hyperlinks can be configured with --hyperlink-format using URL templates or named aliases.
source.why: A fixed editor-specific format removes the configurable hyperlink formats introduced by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
